title: Item cooldown
description: 🗸 Shows the item's cooldown in seconds. It also changes the cooldown color.
body:
## EN
This is a client-side mod that shows the cooldown of an item.

- Red (>5 sec)
- Yellow (0.5-5 sec)
- Green (<0.5 sec)
- Format "X.XX" seconds
  
### 🏆 Support the Author
- 🎯 **[Boosty](https://boosty.to/gvoper)**

> ### 🌐Third-party hosting
> You are not allowed to host the mod on third-party resources. You can post news about the mod, but you must link to this mod page for downloading (or link to the download address from modrinth).
---
  
## RU
Это клиентский мод который показывает кулдаун предмета

- Красный (>5 сек)
- Желтый (0.5-5 сек)
- Зеленый (<0.5 сек)
- Формат "X.XX" секунд

### 🏆 Поддержать автора
